issue_request: FHIR-23022 was a Published Patient Care change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to loosen AdverseEvent.outcome from a required binding to a preferred binding and swap the value set to NCI/NCI Meta outcome concepts.

additional_context: FHIR-25556, a later Published Patient Care issue, explicitly found the preferred NCI binding too strict for international implementers and replaced it with an example SNOMED CT binding rooted at SCTID 405533003. The combined branch already contains a FHIR-25556 audit commit, so that related decision was not duplicated.
